title: blur and sobel passes
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate Gaussian blur followed by Sobel edge detection render passes on a cone.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCameraPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCameraPass.html) — camera pass.
- [vtkConeSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkConeSource.html) — generates a polygonal cone.
- [vtkDataSetSurfaceFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetSurfaceFilter.html) — data set surface filter.
- [vtkGaussianBlurPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGaussianBlurPass.html) — gaussian blur pass.
- [vtkLightsPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLightsPass.html) — lights pass.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkOpaquePass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkOpaquePass.html) — opaque pass.
- [vtkOverlayPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkOverlayPass.html) — overlay pass.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkRTAnalyticSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRTAnalyticSource.html) — generates a synthetic wavelet image volume.
- [vtkRenderPassCollection](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderPassCollection.html) — render pass collection.
- [vtkSequencePass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSequencePass.html) — sequence pass.
- [vtkSobelGradientMagnitudePass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSobelGradientMagnitudePass.html) — sobel gradient magnitude pass.
- [vtkTranslucentPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTranslucentPass.html) — translucent pass.
- [vtkVolumetricPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVolumetricPass.html) — volumetric pass.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
